GET /api.description: serves up a json representation of all the available endpoints of the api

GET /api/topics.description: serves an array of all topics

topics.description: The man, the Mitch, the legend

GET /api/articles.description: serves an array of all articles

articles.title: Living in the shadow of a great man
articles.author: butter_bridge

GET /api/articles/:article_id.description: serves an object of the matching article

article.author: butter_bridge
article.title: Living in the shadow of a great man

PATCH /api/articles/:article_id.description: serves the updated object of the matching article

article.author: butter_bridge
article.title: Living in the shadow of a great man

GET /api/users.description: serves an array of all users

GET /api/articles/:article_id/comments.description: serves an array of all comments of the matching article

POST /api/articles/:article_id/comments.description: serves an object of the posted comment
